llm.title: AI assistant
llm.intro: Explains mistakes in lessons. Works with a model on this computer (LM Studio) or in the cloud (OpenRouter). Lesson content and your answers go only to the provider you choose.
llm.lmstudioHint: In LM Studio: download a model (for example Gemma 4 12B), then turn on the local server under Developer → Status: Running.
llm.openrouterKeyHint: Create a key at openrouter.ai/keys. It is stored encrypted on this computer and never shown again.
llm.keyHint: Only if the server needs one. It is stored encrypted and never shown again.
llm.keySaved: Saved — enter a new one to replace it
llm.connected: Connected · {count, plural, =0 {no models} one {# model} other {# models}} · {ms} ms
llm.modelHint: Pick from the list or type the model name.
llm.setUpHint: Want an explanation? Set up the AI assistant

error.llm_not_configured: Choose a model in Settings → AI assistant.
error.llm_unreachable: The server does not answer. Check the address.
error.lmstudioDown: LM Studio does not answer. Is its local server running?
error.llm_unauthorized: The API key was not accepted.
error.llm_model_not_found: The model was not found on the server.
error.llm_timeout: The model took too long to answer.
error.llm_builtin_unavailable: There is no built-in engine for this computer.
error.llm_model_missing: The chosen model is not downloaded yet — see Settings → AI assistant.
error.llm_engine_failed: The built-in model did not start.

tutor.title: Tutor
tutor.intro: Ask about this lesson: grammar, words, the exercise on screen — or practise a short dialogue. Answers stay within what you have learnt so far.
tutor.needsSetup: The tutor needs an AI model.

local.intro: Runs on this computer, no other apps needed. The engine (llama.cpp) and a model are downloaded once into the data folder ({memory} GB of memory here); larger models explain better but answer slower.
local.unavailable: There is no official llama.cpp build for this computer. Use LM Studio or OpenRouter instead.
local.size: {size} GB · needs about {ram} GB of memory
local.downloadFailed: The download failed. Try again — it continues where it stopped.
local.engineFailed: The llama.cpp engine could not be downloaded: {error}. Press Download again to retry.
